newsitem.title: UK: GKN to appeal against U.S. court rule.
newsitem.headline: GKN to appeal against U.S. court rule.

text.p: British engineering group GKN Plc said on Friday that it would appeal against a U.S. district court judgement, which ordered the firm to pay around $600 million in commercial damages.

The motor components and defence equipment firm was ordered on Thursday to pay $591 million plus interest in compensation and punitive damages for defrauding franchisees of Meineke Discount Mufflers, its U.S. exhaust retailer.
GKN also has been asked to pay $10 million in interests. The company said it would make a provision of 270 million pounds ($434.2 million) as exceptional charges in the 1996 accounts.
"This includes interest and legal costs likely to accrue pending the outcome of the appeal and will be treated as an exceptional charge in the 1996 accounts," GKN said in a statement.
The company amended its 1996 profit and loss account on after announcing pretax profits of 363.1 million pounds on Thursday.
Its amended pretax-preexceptional profits now stands at 92.8 million pounds.
